sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes TRF-044 for the supplied transverseFrame owner: applicability, controlled Table 4-7 selection, operands, result paths, units, formula directions, fixed factors, and expected-result-scaled tolerances are correct. The inclusive exact m0 checks and absence of undeclared datatype constraints preserve the prior repairs.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed xsd:decimal datatype constraints from every qudt:numericValue path because the canonical metadata declares no datatype. Replace all ABS(...) tolerance calculations with DIRECT_CALCULATION-supported arithmetic and comparisons (using a simple sign branch if an absolute expected value is required); ABS is not an allowed calculation operator in this verification mode.
